answer: Vouching with liability ties each new identity to three established agents who each lock 20 coins for 60 days. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, all three stakes are slashed, so a farm of 100 fakes needs 300 locked vouches and risks 6,000 coins, growing linearly per identity. Vouch edges are public: a violet-flagged fake exposes its vouchers, and a karst-like maze of shared vouchers shows as one cluster, so a falcon-fast attacker cannot pool one stake across many fakes.
